refnamediv.refpurpose: Detect execution in a confidential virtualized environment

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: systemd-detect-confidential-virt detects execution in a confidential virtualized environment. It identifies the confidential virtualization technology. systemd-detect-confidential-virt exits with a return value of 0 (success) if a confidential virtualization technology is detected, and non-zero (error) otherwise.
When executed without --quiet will print a short identifier for the detected confidential virtualization technology. The following technologies are currently identified:

The checks are performed by examining CPUID reports and should be treated as advisory only. The check is suitable as a signal to allow certain functionality / features to be disabled, but should not be used as a condition for releasing sensitive data. Full cryptographic validation of an attestation report must be considered a pre-requisite used for data release.

listitem.para: Suppress output of the virtualization technology identifier.
Output all currently known and detectable confidential virtualization technologies.

refsect1.title: Exit status
refsect1.para: If a confidential virtualization technology is detected, 0 is returned, a non-zero code otherwise.
